sources.observed_rule: stage membership by causal signal close time bucket+step
entry must satisfy signal_close <= entry < min(signal_close+20*TF,next_day_boundary)
historical XAU Stage B filters selected trades by entry timestamp
F03 entry must occur before same-day deadline; no next-day entry permitted

proof: For every executable trade, entry_timestamp >= causal_signal_close_timestamp.
Therefore signal close and entry are in the same source-clock calendar day.
Both Stage B boundaries are source-clock day boundaries at the start of 2020-01-01 and 2022-01-01.
Hence signal_close in Stage B iff entry_timestamp in Stage B for every executable trade under the frozen same-day contract.
